fusions.name: Brood Mother's Shove
fusions.desc: Rushes the target and deals 18 damage, leaving it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds. Its damage rises 10% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 30%.

fusions.name: Thunder Flurry
fusions.desc: Beats down on every enemy within 3.5 tiles, dealing 28 damage, plus 5% of the maximum health of any boss or elite it hits. Your movement speed rises 20% for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Puffed Up
fusions.desc: Increases your damage by 35% for 15 seconds. An escort of chicks fights beside you for 20 seconds, striking for 4 every 1.4 seconds.

fusions.name: Cornered Mettle
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 40%, you deal 50% more damage for 8 seconds. Once every 30 seconds. Your armour is also 8% higher at all times.
